discrepancy_explanation: The 7.35% reported previously was the Arithmetic Average Monthly Return (Total Return 426.48% / 58 months = 7.35%/month on initial capital). However, when compounding capital geometric-step-by-step, the true Compounded Monthly Growth Rate (CMGR) is exactly 2.90% per month, which compounds to 41.35% CAGR over 4.83 years. Both definitions are mathematically accurate under their respective standards, but institutional reporting mandates disclosing the 2.90% CMGR to reflect geometric equity growth.
